title: RT-J: Large-Scale Pretraining of Relational Transformers for Context-Efficient Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2610.17867v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models for tables and relational databases are increasingly used for predictive tasks across various scientific and industrial domains. However, adapting existing models to unseen datasets requires tens of thousands of examples. Here we introduce RT-J, an 85M-parameter relational foundation model (RFM) that makes accurate predictions even with hundreds of in-context examples or fewer. To achieve this, we first assemble the Join, a large collection of 639 web-crawled databases with 6,023 LLM-generated forecasting tasks. We pretrain with long contexts of up to 8,192 database cells, using in-context examples from a novel lightweight random-walk retriever. Finally, we leverage context tuning and ensembling to scale up test-time compute. On in-context regression tasks from RelBench, RT-J requires 10x fewer examples on average to match strong feature engineering pipelines with LLM-agent or RDBLearn featurizers and TabICLv2 or Ligh

translated_title: RT-J：用于上下文高效预测的关系型Transformer大规模预训练
translated_abstract: 用于表格和关系型数据库的基础模型在各个科学和工业领域的预测任务中应用日益广泛。然而，将现有模型适配到未见过的数据集需要数万个样本。在此，我们推出了RT-J，一个8500万参数的关系型基础模型（RFM），即使只有数百个甚至更少的上下文样本也能做出准确预测。为实现这一目标，我们首先构建了"Join"数据集，这是一个大型数据集合，包含639个网络爬取的数据库以及6,023个由大语言模型生成的预测任务。我们使用长达8,192个数据库单元格的长上下文进行预训练，并通过一种新颖的轻量级随机游走检索器获取上下文样本。最后，我们利用上下文调优和集成方法来扩展测试时计算。在来自RelBench的上下文回归任务上，RT-J平均只需少10倍的样本即可匹敌采用LLM智能体或RDBLearn特征化器以及TabICLv2或Ligh（摘要截断）的强大特征工程流水线。
tldr: RT-J是一个8500万参数的关系型基础模型，通过在639个网络爬取数据库和LLM生成的预测任务上利用长上下文预训练，仅需数百个上下文样本即可实现准确预测，所需样本量比现有方法减少10倍。
en_tdlr: RT-J is an 85M-parameter relational foundation model pretrained on 639 web-crawled databases with LLM-generated forecasting tasks using long contexts, achieving accurate predictions with as few as hundreds of in-context examples—requiring 10x fewer examples than existing methods.
